description: Upload a local document (PDF, DOCX, TXT, or MD) to FAQai and optionally start processing it into RAG datasets. Uses FAQai's presigned upload flow, so large files work up to the plan's file-size limit. Consumes monthly page quota when processing runs — the tool checks remaining quota before uploading and refuses if it is exhausted. After upload with auto_process (default), poll get_processing_status until the document is completed.

auto_process.description: Start dataset generation immediately after upload (default true). Set false to upload only; processing can be started later with process_document.

chunking.description: Chunking profile: a preset name (balanced ~400 tokens, fine_grained ~200, large_context ~800) or custom values (paid plans), e.g. {target_tokens: 256, overlap_pct: 10, strategy: 'fixed_size'}.

contextual_enrichment.description: Add an AI context header and hypothetical questions to each RAG chunk for better retrieval (paid plans). Applies to the RAG dataset path and consumes enrichment units from the monthly quota.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the local file to upload (.pdf, .docx, .txt, or .md)

generation_context.description: Audience/use-case steering for dataset generation (paid plans): a preset id (customer_support_bot, internal_knowledge_base, developer_docs_assistant, sales_enablement, compliance_legal) or free text like 'chatbot for hotel guests'.

name.description: Display name for the document (defaults to the filename)

name: upload_document
title: Upload Document
